headline: Virginia Fonseca Donates One Million Reais To The AACD Charity
metaDescription: Influencer Virginia Fonseca donated one million reais to the AACD following her decision to withdraw from her scheduled appearance at the SBT Teleton.
aiSummaryBullets: Virginia Fonseca contributed one million reais to the AACD organization.
The donation followed the cancellation of her participation in the SBT Teleton event.
The funds provided by the influencer were not included in the official tally for the television fundraising marathon.
aiContextParagraph: The AACD is a prominent organization focused on providing specialized healthcare and rehabilitation services. In November 2026, influencer Virginia Fonseca visited the main headquarters of the association. This engagement preceded her decision to withdraw from a planned appearance at the Teleton, an annual televised fundraising event hosted by the Brazilian television network SBT. Following this cancellation, it was reported that Fonseca made a private donation of one million reais to the charity. According to reports, this significant contribution was handled separately from the totals collected during the televised broadcast marathon. The event surrounding the donation and the scheduling change has drawn public interest, particularly regarding the influencer's involvement with the philanthropic initiative.
